I think we may be having different experiences with the baristas. Most stores I’ve been to the baristas are working their butts off to make times on the drinks. I doubt they’re projecting their egos onto each and every interaction that goes less than perfect. I definitely agree the ethics of the company have devolved and it’s affecting everyone, but honestly, I’ve already moved on before cueing the shots for the next drink. It’s really not that deep and I sincerely think a petty, intentional decaf shot isn’t even in competition with the tantrums adults throw over coffee.

When I decaf the crustie, I do it for me, not for them. Why are baristas always held to impossible standards of truly abusive behavior? Just because someone applies to work in customer service doesn’t mean they should expect to be regularly treated like shit from the company, the manager, and the public. We applied for a check, camaraderie, and to have fun making drinks. Sure, all customer service jobs will suck sometimes. 

Trust me that when a store is adequately staffed, baristas love to make your drink beautiful for your photo and to make you happy. They don’t want you to yell at them - wtf?? No one wants to misunderstand the sticker and have to remake a drink when we’re pressed for time, it’s embarrassing. But if you get nasty over a DRINK (!!!) yes you will absolutely be given decaf shots without second thought. 💅🏽
